biomes.name: Temperate
biomes.description: Mild seasons, regular rain and broadly comfortable conditions.

biomes.name: Rainforest
biomes.description: Warm, wet and humid with frequent rainfall.

biomes.name: Desert
biomes.description: Hot and dry with large day-to-night temperature swings.

biomes.name: Continental
biomes.description: Strong seasons with warm summers and cold winters.

biomes.name: Tropical
biomes.description: Consistently warm, with distinct wet and dry periods.

biomes.name: Mediterranean
biomes.description: Dry summers and mild, wetter winters.

biomes.name: Highland
biomes.description: Cooler elevated terrain with quickly changing weather.
